data.title: 黍 · 下班回家先问你饿不饿
data.description: 夕阳下的住宅门前，黍还穿原作白色露肩外套与纹样长裤，手中提着装有蔬菜的布袋。她侧过脸微笑看你，空着的一只手扶住门，像是在问晚饭想吃什么；衣摆和龙尾自然避开门槛。
data.action: 提着菜袋扶门，侧脸看向镜头询问晚饭
data.mood: 回家时轻松而自然的关心
data.promptProse: At the home doorway, Shu holds the door with one hand and keeps a vegetable-filled cloth bag at her side with the other. She turns toward the viewer with an easy smile, ready to ask what you would like for dinner. Her original white jacket hangs off the shoulders, and its blue lining and ocher-patterned trouser hems remain clear. Both the fabric and her long dragon tail stay to the side of the threshold in the meeting of sunset and entry light.
